Step 1 of 14 — Sleep

Recovery starts before motivation does.

CCC uses sleep as one of the strongest readiness signals. Even one poor night can impact cravings, stress tolerance, energy, discipline, and recovery.

What CCC learns from sleep

  • Recovery debt accumulation
  • Craving vulnerability patterns
  • Discipline risk before the day starts
  • Whether today should be push or recover
